_about: Copy this file to ~/.omnibutler/config.json (or point $OMNIBUTLER_CONFIG at it) and fill in your own values. Secret fields (token, local_key) should be references like "env:HA_TOKEN" so the real key lives in an environment variable, not in this file; a literal value also works - the setup helper writes this file with 0600 permissions. See omnibutler/setup_guide.py for how to fetch each key yourself.
